Frequently asked questions

Important details before you begin.

Does ClarityGrid provide legal or tax advice?

No. Payroll administration and accounting support do not replace legal counsel or a tax professional. Registrations and filings are confirmed as part of engagement scope.

Which payroll platforms are supported?

Experience includes ADP, Paycor, Gusto, Workday and Thomson Reuters environments. Platform fit is confirmed during assessment.
